8. Prove both cancellations and the accurate inverse normTake the inverse of the derived unit and prove both products equal the identity by application congruence. Cauchy–Schwarz gives γ‖f‖≤‖Γ_0f‖; substitute f=Inv g to obtain ‖Inv‖≤1/γ. The full-space constant kernel is kept separate.InvΓ0=Γ0Inv=I,‖Inv‖≤γ−1=1+αη2αη.Corresponding Lean step  let Inv : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0 := ↑(hUnit.unit⁻¹)
  have hLeft : Inv*ΓP0=1 := by
    exact (congrArg (fun C : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0 => Inv*C) hUnit.unit_spec).symm.trans
      (Units.inv_mul hUnit.unit)
  have hRight : ΓP0*Inv=1 := by
    exact (congrArg (fun C : HP0 →L[ℝ] HP0 => C*Inv) hUnit.unit_spec).symm.trans
      (Units.mul_inv hUnit.unit)
  have hNormCoerc (f : HP0) : γ*‖f‖ ≤ ‖ΓP0 f‖ := by
    by_cases hf : f=0
    · simp [hf]
